headline: **MLB Daily Recap: July 9, 2026**
article:
The Atlanta Braves secured a decisive victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, winning 10-5 behind Jake Mangum's standout performance. The New York Mets also secured a win, taking down the Kansas City Royals 7-3. The Yankees dominated the Tampa Bay Rays 12-4, with Ben Rice leading the offense. The Cubs fell short in Baltimore, losing 2-3.

Injuries and availability impacted several teams, with Tanner Banks being placed on the 15-day injured list by the Philadelphia Phillies due to a left forearm strain. Other notable injuries include Brad Lord's left side tightness, Owen Caissie's right calf strain, and Ranger Suarez's left groin strain.

The New York Mets made a trade, acquiring right-handed pitcher Matt Seelinger from the Detroit Tigers in exchange for cash. The Minnesota Twins also made a trade, acquiring right-handed pitcher Woo-Suk Go from the Detroit Tigers in exchange for cash.

top_news.title: **Braves Blast Past Pirates 10-5**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves secured a decisive victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, winning the game 10-5. Jake Mangum led the Braves' offense with a standout performance, collecting 4 hits, including a home run, and driving in 3 runs.

top_news.title: **Mets Take Down Royals 7-3**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets secured a 7-3 victory over the Kansas City Royals, with Sean Manaea earning the win after 7.0 innings of work. Tyrone Taylor led the Royals' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, while Juan Soto's 21st homer of the season was a key play for the Mets.

top_news.title: **Yankees Cruise Past Rays 12-4**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees dominated the Tampa Bay Rays, securing a 12-4 victory. Ben Rice led the Yankees' offense with 2 home runs and 5 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Cubs Fall Short in Baltimore**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs dropped a close game to the Baltimore Orioles, losing 2-3. Seiya Suzuki led the Cubs' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance.

top_news.title: **Phillies Place Tanner Banks on 15-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Tanner Banks, a left-handed pitcher for the Philadelphia Phillies, has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a left forearm strain.

top_news.title: **Mets Acquire RHP Matt Seelinger in Trade**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets have acquired right-handed pitcher Matt Seelinger in a trade with the Detroit Tigers, who received cash in return.
